name: Joshi Ana
source:
The main character is a TV producer. He joined a TV company because he really liked female newscasters. He is now in charge of a news program. The program is very popular, especially among men, because he uses a lot of beautiful newscasters. However, he always takes advantage of his position and gets secrets of the newscasters.... Like this, he sleeps with various newscasters. One day, two newscasters take charge of his news program and work hard to comply with his requests. Once he has sex with them, his requests gradually get bolder....
